Medical Students
UCI School of Medicine is ranked among the top 50 U.S. medical schools for research by U.S. News & World Report. We are dedicated to advancing medical knowledge and clinical practice through scholarly research, physician education and high-quality care.
Graduate Students
Our student scholars in the clinical and basic sciences are trained in biomedical research and critical inquiry with the goal of a career in research, biomedical technology or academic education.

Our curriculum is designed to give you hands-on training at the UCI Medical Center, as well as community clinics and health-care centers.

Basic Research

Translational Science Research
At UCI, we encourage the translation of biomedical research into new and better cures and treatments.

40 Years in the Light
The UC Irvine Beckman Laser Institute & Medical Clinic is celebrating 40 years of innovation in science and medicine. Discover how a rainy-morning handshake between a young UC Irvine biologist and an 80-year-old industrialist built one of the world’s most influential laser medicine institutions.

Oct 22, 2026 |
Common Cholesterol Drugs Show Promise Against Chemotherapy-Resistant Pancreatic Cancer
Pancreatic cancer can become harder to treat when tumors stop responding to chemotherapy, leaving patients and families with few options. UC Irvine researchers have identified a weakness that emerges as cancer cells resist a widely used chemotherapeutic, pointing to a possible new use for cholesterol-lowering statins.

PhD Graduate Mahina Mitul Joins the Vaccine Research Center
Mahina Mitul talks about finding her path to becoming a postdoc at the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, including the tweet that led her from Bangladesh to UC Irvine.

Curated with Care: Medical Students Brighten Local Health Clinic with Art
UC Irvine medical students Tatum Ego and Zoe Adams collaborate with the nonprofit Art for the Isolated to help beautify a free healthcare clinic for the underserved, creating a more welcoming space.
